title: Granik 1973 rib modulus of elasticity, demineralised/pathological cases

quantity.name: modulus of elasticity
quantity.definition: bending modulus from three-point bending (beam theory)

source.sample: rib segments from 15 autopsy patients: 10 with radiologically normal bone, 5 with diffuse demineralisation (3 multiple myeloma, 1 rheumatoid arthritis, 1 ankylosing spondylitis)

protocol.summary: Autopsy rib segments tested as simply supported, centrally loaded beams over a 4 in (101.6 mm) span (rubber-sheathed maple wedge plunger), quasi-static to failure; E from linear load-deflection and moment of inertia (plaster/plastic replica checks); sigma = modulus of rupture.
how_to_simulate: Model a rib segment as a simply supported beam (101.6 mm span) loaded at midspan
Report E (beam theory from load-deflection slope) and modulus of rupture at failure

extraction.check_notes: Table 1 read from 200-dpi render. psi -> MPa (x0.00689476); original in 'orig'. Only normals have mean +- SD; abnormal cases listed individually (E only approximate for abnormal bones per authors). doi not printed.

pass_rule.rule: |model - mean| <= 1 SD (or inside [min, max] when no SD)
